mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with declines in FEDFUNDS during periods of monetary easing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) suggests stronger economic demand, which can positively impact corporate earnings and thus drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% but S&P 500 returns do not increase over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, which can lead to decreased consumer spending and negative impacts on S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp but S&P 500 returns do not show a negative trend over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests increased economic activity, which can lead to higher corporate revenues and thus drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but S&P 500 returns do not show a positive trend over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weaker demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative impacts on related sectors and thus drive down S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases but S&P 500 returns do not show a negative trend over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) suggests a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and thus drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns do not show a positive trend over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflation, which can lead to tighter monetary policy and thus drive down S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 230 but S&P 500 returns do not show a negative trend over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which can lead to higher corporate revenues and thus drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but S&P 500 returns do not show a positive trend over the next 60 days.
